section_anchor: Why cooling attention after a close is normal, not alarming
brief_summary: Two line charts sharing the same W30-W32 axis. GMK CYL TA Neo (bordeaux, focal) starts ahead at 62 and declines to 50 then 40. GMK CYL OG Extensions (muted grey, secondary) starts behind at 58 and climbs to 62 then 70, the two lines crossing between W30 and W31 as the closed TA Neo buy cools and the still-open OG Extensions buy gains attention heading into its own August 12 close.
